verdict.rationale: For the annual report and franchise tax filing, the entry page states its prerequisites up front. It asks only for a Business Entity File Number, links a name search for anyone who needs that number, carries an image CAPTCHA, and takes an optional saved session ID, with no account required to start. Formation docs list the submission channels (upload, fax, mail, and the Document Filing and Certificate Request Service) but never say what account, credential or identity steps that service needs. Missing for 10: an explicit published statement of account, credential and identity-proofing requirements for formation filings, a consolidated pre-flow disclosure covering all filing paths, and independent or hands-on confirmation that no undisclosed steps appear mid-flow.
